name: Shiritsu VerBara Gakuen ~Versailles no Bara Re*imagination~
original_name: 私立ベルばら学園 ～ベルサイユのばらRe*imagination～
source:
VerRose Academy - the famous private school everyone dreams of attending. A girl named Yamada Oskar is about to walk through its doors.

At the entrance ceremony performance, when she sees the dazzling "Oscar" on stage in a gorgeous costume, her heart begins to pound like an alarm bell.

"Is this... love!?"

She meets another Oscar - Maki Nozomi - and after much deliberation, accepts an invitation to join the newly formed theater troupe, Lumiere.

All set to fight for the championship! Or so she thought - instead, she finds herself surrounded by eccentric personalities, caught up in sudden major incidents, and even pressured to switch clubs!?

Can she overcome countless hardships and seize the competition crown? And what will become of Yamada Oskar's love—

A clubroom drama of love and youth - the curtain rises!

[Translated from the [url=https://www.otomate.jp/berubara-gakuen/story/]official site[/url]]
